vectors.name: assign-01-bernoulli-p50
vectors.exercises: bernoulli design, treat_fraction 0.5, 4 cohorts; commitment(seed) and seed->assignment shown as distinct steps

vectors.name: assign-02-fixed-count-2of5
vectors.exercises: fixed_count design, exactly 2 of 5 cohorts treated (exact balance, prf-ranked, cohort_id tie-break)

vectors.name: assign-03-bernoulli-p25
vectors.exercises: bernoulli design, treat_fraction 0.25, 6 cohorts, different seed (control-heavy expected)

vectors.name: assign-04-bernoulli-p0-allcontrol
vectors.exercises: bernoulli boundary treat_fraction_ppm=0 -> EVERY cohort control (no positive payout possible); 4 cohorts

vectors.name: assign-05-bernoulli-p1000000-alltreat
vectors.exercises: bernoulli boundary treat_fraction_ppm=1000000 -> EVERY cohort treatment; 4 cohorts

vectors.name: assign-06-fixed-count-0of5-allcontrol
vectors.exercises: fixed_count boundary treatment_count=0 -> EVERY cohort control; 5 cohorts

vectors.name: assign-07-fixed-count-5of5-alltreat
vectors.exercises: fixed_count boundary treatment_count=n -> EVERY cohort treatment; 5 cohorts

vectors.name: assign-08-bernoulli-single-cohort
vectors.exercises: single-leaf tree: assignment_root == leaf_hash(sole leaf), no interior node; n=1 (Merkle base case)

vectors.name: assign-09-fixed-count-lexical-order
vectors.exercises: cohort_id ordering is UTF-16 code-unit LEXICAL, not numeric: 'cohort-10' sorts BEFORE 'cohort-2'. Inputs supplied SCRAMBLED to prove the derivation reorders deterministically. fixed_count 3 of 6. This is the cross-language ordering footgun (naive numeric sort diverges here).

vectors.name: assign-10-bernoulli-16cohorts
vectors.exercises: 16 cohorts, balanced power-of-2 tree (4 levels, no promotion); bernoulli 0.5; zero-padded ids so lexical order == numeric order

vectors.name: assign-11-fixed-count-3of7
vectors.exercises: 7 cohorts (odd) exercises odd-node PROMOTION at multiple levels; fixed_count exactly 3 treated

vectors.name: assign-12-switchback-2geo-2period
vectors.exercises: switchback design: 2 geo-cohorts x 2 periods. Per-geo randomized phase bit + parity alternation across periods; arm flips every period within a geo. treated_fraction_micro MUST be 500000. Leaf carries the FULL composite cohort_id and leaves sort by the FULL id (§7.5/§6.2).

vectors.name: assign-13-switchback-3geo-noncontiguous
vectors.exercises: switchback with 3 geo-cohorts and NON-CONTIGUOUS period indices (arm is a pure function of (group,index) regardless of gaps). Different seed; odd total leaf count (5) exercises odd-node promotion in the assignment tree.

vectors.name: assign-14-matched-pairs-2x2
vectors.exercises: matched_cluster canonical MATCHED PAIRS: two strata, each m_s=2, treated_fraction_micro=500000 -> k_s=round_he(1.0)=1 (exactly one of each pair treated). Ranked by (full-id prf, member_index).

vectors.name: assign-15-matched-mixed-strata-halfeven
vectors.exercises: matched_cluster mixed strata exercising round-half-to-EVEN at the exact .5 tie: stratum sA has m_s=3, frac=500000 -> 1.5 -> k_s=2 (q=1 odd -> q+1); stratum sB has m_s=2 -> k_s=1. Proves banker's rounding + clamp, and per-stratum independence.
